description: Bounded verification of live Los Angeles County assessor parcel queries and source terms.

licence.confirmed: County terms read in a headed browser permit copying, publishing, distributing, adapting, and commercial or personal use; county endorsement is excluded and recommended citation is given.

identityLimits: AIN is a 10-character assessor identifier; bounded samples establish neither countywide completeness nor globally unique IDs. Conflicting geometries fail closed in the adapter.
scope: Los Angeles County only; adjacent counties require separate providers. Assessment polygons are not a legal survey or separate condominium title boundaries.

browserVerification.globePopup: Live city with source streaming description and Open city action
browserVerification.globeHandoff: Open city navigates to its configured source at zoom 19 and streams parcels
